function report({state,workflow,now,chatId}){const items=state.items,workflowName=workflow.name;if(!Array.isArray(items)||typeof workflowName!=='string'||!workflowName.trim()||workflowName.startsWith('YOUR_')||typeof chatId!=='string'||!chatId.trim()||chatId.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Set the workflow name and Telegram chat');const t=Date.parse(now);if(!Number.isFinite(t))throw Error('Invalid report time');const lines=[];for(const e of items){if(!['canceled','crashed','error','new','running','success','unknown','waiting'].includes(e.status)||typeof e.startedAt!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(e.startedAt))||e.id===undefined||e.id===null)throw Error('Invalid execution');if(['error','crashed'].includes(e.status)&&Date.parse(e.startedAt)>t-604800000&&Date.parse(e.startedAt)<=t)lines.push(`⚠️ Workflow ${workflowName} failed. Execution ${e.id}; started ${e.startedAt}`)}const text=lines.join('\n');if(text.length>4096)throw Error('Report exceeds the Telegram message limit');return {send:lines.length>0,text:text||'No unfinished executions',chatId,count:lines.length}}

const x=report({state:{items:$input.all().map(x=>x.json)},workflow:{name:'YOUR_N8N_WORKFLOW_NAME'},now:new Date().toISOString(),chatId:'YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID'});return x.send?[{json:x}]:[];
